findings.title: Parent sweep exit and full output are not retained by the cited receipt

evidence.output: Directory contains static.json, milestones.json, regression.json/stdout/stderr, sweep.py and ten per-leg directories; no parent-driver process receipt listed.
Five constituent static records with exit_code 0; no parent python3 sweep.py outcome.
Historical git show output is replaced with selected numbered excerpts; driver stores constituent static and child regression records, then prints JSON; it does not retain its own exit/stdout/stderr.

findings.impact: Missing parent process provenance only; not evidence of driver failure and not a contradiction of the retained ten-leg result.
findings.recommendation: Narrow full-retention assertion to retained constituent records/excerpts, or bind an existing original parent transcript; do not forge or rerun receipts.

documentary_results.retained_summary: REGRESSION: PASS (cases=10 passed=10; ledger legs exact: killed-delta<=0 flips<=0)

method: Read committed source using git show only; compare source bytes and retained local JSON/TSV/log contents in memory. No imported repository code or candidate execution.
residual_risk: Unsigned local receipts do not authenticate execution, exactly-once replay, or absence of transient writes.
No current integration or 64/64 monitor measurement.
No runtime, rerouting, resume continuity, saturation, cross-host, or repeated-run certification.
